issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Scholé Learn by Building
products.tagline: Learning should be more than "click next"
products.summaryZh: 学习不应只是“点击下一步”
products.descriptionZh: 在任何网站上边做边学，Scholé 伴你左右。你可以阅读工具介绍，看 YouTube 上别人的操作演示，或让 ChatGPT 解释。但只有亲手实践，才能真正学会。Learn Anywhere 模式直接在屏幕上引导你使用任何真实工具，动态调整任务并提供视觉提示。你学到的一切都会更新 Scholé 知识图谱，并计入课程进度。我们的理念？学到足以运用自如。
products.description: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

products.name: Floot MCP
products.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 在Claude或ChatGPT中构建并发布Web和移动应用
products.descriptionZh: 将 Floot 连接到 Claude 或 ChatGPT，无需离开聊天即可构建全栈应用。Floot 为你的 AI 提供一个即用型工作空间，包含数据库、用户登录、托管和实时 URL——无需安装或配置。你现有的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 订阅负责思考，因此 Floot 不按 AI 使用量收费。准备就绪后，将同一项目发布到 Web、iOS 和 Android，然后继续在同一对话中持续交付更新。
products.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

products.name: NOAN
products.tagline: The fact layer for your AI agents
products.summaryZh: 你的AI代理的事实层
products.descriptionZh: 你的公司有成千上万份文档，但真相只有一个版本。NOAN 将你的企业已批准的事实——如定价、定位、政策、产品、客户等——转化为经过验证、带版本管理的真相来源，并通过 API 和 MCP 提供。连接任何模型、智能体或应用，让它们获得相同的公司事实，而不是让每个 AI 对文档做出不同解读。
products.description: Your company has thousands of documents, but only one version of the truth. NOAN turns the facts your business has approved such as pricing, positioning, policies, products, customers, and more into a verified, versioned source of truth available through API and MCP. Connect any model, agent, or app and give them all the same company facts, instead of letting each AI interpret your documents differently.

products.name: minimi 2.0
products.tagline: AI cat that closes your open loops
products.summaryZh: 帮你收尾未竟事项的AI猫
products.descriptionZh: minimi 是主动来到你身边的个人智能。我们正在构建一个世界：在你开口之前，AI 就已经理解你，把你从管理自己生活的琐事中解放出来，让你把时间真正花在生活本身。现在，你可以在 minimi 上领养 AI 猫 🐱：1. Cotton 捕捉你的个人上下文，让你再也不必向 AI 解释自己。2. Melody 利用这些个人上下文，让你永远不会错过承诺。更多猫 🐈 🐈‍⬛ 即将到来……
products.description: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. We are building a world where before you've said a word, AI already understands you and frees you from the work of managing your own life, so you can spend that time actually living it. Right now, you can adopt AI cats 🐱 on minimi: 1. Cotton captures your personal context so you never explain yourself to AI again. 2. Melody uses this personal context and never lets you miss your commitments More cats 🐈 🐈‍⬛ to come soon...

products.name: CtrlOps 1.0
products.tagline: Your server. Audited, managed, and deployed with AI.
products.summaryZh: 你的服务器。由AI审计、管理并部署。
products.descriptionZh: 你真的知道现在谁有权访问你的服务器吗？CtrlOps 通过 25 项检查为你提供安全加固评分、PDF 审计报告，以及针对每个发现问题的修复命令。查看谁能登录每台服务器，一键撤销整个服务器集群的访问权限，无需接触终端即可分配任意级别的角色/访问权限。每个日志文件都能被找到并搜索，无需 SSH。几分钟内即可从 GitHub 部署任何应用。100% 本地。你的凭据永远不会离开你的机器。
products.description: Do you actually know who has access to your servers right now? CtrlOps gives you a security hardening score across 25 checks, a PDF audit report, and fix commands for every issue found. See who can log into every server, revoke access from your whole fleet in one click, and assign any level of roles/access without touching the terminal. Every log file, found and searchable without SSH. Deploy any app from GitHub in minutes. 100% local. Your credentials never leave your machine.

products.name: Hookest
products.tagline: Your swipe file for viral video hooks
products.summaryZh: 你的病毒视频钩子素材库
products.descriptionZh: Hookest 追踪爆款 TikTok、Reels 和 Shorts 的开头几秒，并让它们可被搜索，同时附带真实的表现数据。研究你所在领域内有效的内容，观察竞争对手，并通过 MCP 将保存的钩子带入 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Gemini。
products.description: Hookest tracks the opening seconds of viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts and makes them searchable with real performance data. Study what’s working in your niche, watch competitors, and bring saved hooks into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini through MCP.

products.name: Bitrise Build Hub
products.tagline: GitHub Actions runners that build 2x faster for your agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的代理构建速度提升2倍的GitHub Actions运行器
products.descriptionZh: 编码代理会推送更多代码，因此你的 CI 会比以往运行更多构建。GitHub 的 runner 速度慢，所以每次额外的构建都会在队列中等待，你的团队也只能跟着等。Bitrise Build Hub 则在最新的 Apple Silicon 和高核心 Linux 上运行这些构建：iOS 上快 54%，Android 上快 31%。PR 几分钟内就能返回，你的应用也能更早发布。你继续使用 GitHub Actions。只需在工作流中改一行，就能在专为移动端打造的最佳 runner 上运行。
products.description: Coding agents push more code, so your CI runs more builds than ever. GitHub's runners are slow, so every extra build sits in the queue and your team waits with it. Bitrise Build Hub runs those builds on the newest Apple Silicon and high-core Linux instead: 54% faster on iOS, 31% on Android. PRs come back in minutes, and your app ships sooner. You keep GitHub Actions. Changing one line in your workflow is all it takes to run on the best runners made for mobile.

products.name: Opaline
products.tagline: PostHog for team Claude Code and Codex sessions.
products.summaryZh: PostHog 用于团队 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话。
products.descriptionZh: 面向团队的 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话消息级分析。追踪团队会话中每条消息的 token 成本、时间和技能使用情况。捕捉 Claude 的每一句“You're absolutely right”，以及沮丧队友的每一句“I know, you f*cking idiot”。
products.description: Team-wide, message-level analytics for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Track token cost, time, and skill usage for every single message across your team’s sessions. Catch every “You’re absolutely right” from Claude and every “I know, you f*cking idiot” from a frustrated teammate.

products.name: Maximem Synap
products.tagline: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
products.summaryZh: 为AI代理提供的最快、最准确的内存层
products.descriptionZh: Maximem Synap 是面向 AI 智能体的记忆与上下文基础设施，让每次对话都不必从零开始。在公开基准测试中，它是最快、最准确的记忆系统，LongMemEval 得分 92%，Locomo 得分 93.2%，P75 召回延迟低于 15 毫秒。它自动处理实体解析、时间推理和多级作用域，无需调优向量数据库或排序器。原生支持 22 个框架，包括 LangChain、LangGraph 和 Claude Agent SDK。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。
products.description: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. It is the fastest and most accurate memory system on public benchmarks, 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on Locomo, with sub-15ms P75 recall. It handles entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and multi-level scoping automatically, no vector database or ranker to tune. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.

products.name: Autonomous Product Delivery
products.tagline: Discover, plan, build, ship, repeat. Product teams run it
products.summaryZh: 发现、规划、构建、交付、重复。产品团队如此运作
products.descriptionZh: AI 编码智能体让写代码变快了，交付却依然缓慢，因为编码只是产品周期中的一环。自主产品交付将整个循环作为一个系统运行在你的真实代码库上。你可以提问，也可以让它自行建议下一步改进：作为循环中的最后一环，全新的 Discover 模式会研究你的分析数据、工单、通话记录和代码，随后系统进行规划、构建、验证，并向你的工程师交付一个可供审查的 PR。每一次合并都让它更智能。
products.description: AI coding agents made code fast; delivery still crawls, because coding is one seat in the product cycle. Autonomous Product Delivery runs the whole loop as one system on your real codebase. Ask a question, or let it suggest the next improvement on its own: The final piece in the loop, the new Discover Mode, researches your analytics, tickets, calls, and code, then the system plans, builds, verifies, and hands your engineers a review-ready PR. Every merge makes it smarter.

products.name: jev-seo
products.tagline: Free Rust CLI SEO/GEO auditor, no subscription needed
products.summaryZh: 免费的 Rust CLI SEO/GEO 审计工具，无需订阅
products.descriptionZh: Semrush 和 Ahrefs 每月花费 130 美元以上，做的却大多是确定性工作：抓取网站、检查 meta 标签、验证 schema、查看 AI 爬虫能看到什么。jev-seo 用一个免费的 Rust CLI 完成这些。无需订阅，核心检查（抓取、审计、schema、robots、sitemap）不需要付费 API 密钥。可选的 Jev 驱动语义评分（意图分类、GEO/AI 引用评分）需要一个免费 API 密钥。还可作为 MCP 服务器提供给编码代理。cargo install jev-seo
products.description: Semrush and Ahrefs cost $130+/month for work that's mostly deterministic: crawling a site, checking meta tags, validating schema, checking what AI crawlers can see. jev-seo does that in a free Rust CLI. No subscription, no paid API keys needed for the core checks (crawl, audit, schema, robots, sitemap). Optional Jev-powered semantic scoring (intent classification, GEO/AI-citation scoring) needs a free API key. Also ships as an MCP server for coding agents. cargo install jev-seo

products.name: Opencontroller by lyzr
products.tagline: Govern All your agents with a unified control plane
products.summaryZh: 以统一控制平面治理你的所有代理
products.descriptionZh: AI代理正遍布云、SaaS工具、Kubernetes和设备，却缺乏统一的治理层。OpenController是统一的控制平面，能发现每个代理、模型和工作流，通过评估与治理安全交付，进行实时监控，并将使用信号转化为行动。与仅列出代理的注册表不同，OpenController部署到你自己的集群中，由你的密钥管理，并在策略拒绝时于请求路径中拒绝调用。
products.description: AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

products.name: NotchPop
products.tagline: The Dynamic Island your MacBook notch was missing
products.summaryZh: 你的MacBook刘海所缺失的灵动岛
products.descriptionZh: NotchPop 把 MacBook 的刘海变成灵动岛：音乐、文件架、剪贴板历史、专注计时器、日历、天气、AI 编程统计和收入。没有刘海的 Mac 也能用。原生 SwiftUI，一次性 3.99 美元，7 天免费试用。
products.description: NotchPop turns your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: music, a file shelf, clipboard history, focus timer, calendar, weather, AI coding stats and revenue. Works on Macs without a notch too. Native SwiftUI, $3.99 once, 7-day free trial.

products.name: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech models
products.tagline: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
products.summaryZh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
products.descriptionZh: 在 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini Enterprise、Gemini Notebook 和 Google Vids 中生成自定义角色语音并指导场景对话。
products.description: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

products.name: IntellAgents.io
products.tagline: One AI agent for every call, chat, and DM
products.summaryZh: 每个电话、聊天和私信都有一个AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 大多数企业为每个渠道使用不同的工具——电话支持一个，WhatsApp一个，网站聊天机器人又一个。IntellAgents用一个AI代理取代所有这些，它能接听来电、拨出电话，并处理WhatsApp、Instagram、Facebook、Telegram和你的网站——全天候实时运行，支持多达36种语言，全部基于你一次性设置的单一知识库。
products.description: Most businesses juggle a different tool for every channel — one for phone support, another for WhatsApp, another for the website chatbot. IntellAgents replaces all of it with one AI agent that answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, and handles WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and your website — live 24/7, in up to 36 languages, from a single knowledge base you set up once.

products.name: Harness Manager
products.tagline: Your AI coding stack manager, all in one place
products.summaryZh: 你的AI编码栈管理器，一站式管理
products.descriptionZh: Harness Manager 是 Mac 上 AI 编码工具的 App Store 和控制中心。发现、安装并更新 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Pi 等工具。自动检测已安装的内容，管理 MCP 服务器和 AI 技能，检查版本和路径，诊断损坏的安装或配置问题。你的整个 AI 编码栈，终于汇聚一处。
products.description: Harness Manager is the App Store and control center for AI coding harnesses on Mac. Discover, install and update tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more. Automatically detect what’s already installed, manage MCP servers and AI skills, check versions and paths, and diagnose broken installations or configuration issues. Your entire AI coding stack, finally in one place.

products.name: Parall
products.tagline: Run multiple instances of the same app on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在你的Mac上运行同一应用的多个实例
products.descriptionZh: Parall 让你运行多个 macOS 应用实例，并将网站转换为 Web App 快捷方式，支持独特的 Dock 图标、自定义数据路径、HOME 覆盖、环境变量、Dock 效果、文件/文件夹快捷方式以及命令行启动器。
products.description: Parall lets you run multiple instances of macOS apps and turn websites into Web App Shortcuts with unique Dock icons, custom data paths, HOME overrides, environment variables, Dock effects, file/folder shortcuts, and command-line launchers.

products.name: LockLines
products.tagline: Design Mac lock screen messages that fit
products.summaryZh: 设计适合 Mac 锁屏的消息
products.descriptionZh: LockLines 是一款 macOS 应用，用于设计适合小消息区域的纯文本锁屏消息。
products.description: LockLines is a macOS app for designing plain-text lock screen messages that fit the small message area.

products.name: ChoreDivider
products.tagline: Split chores by what each of you actually minds doing
products.summaryZh: 按你们各自真正介意做的家务来分工
products.descriptionZh: 每个家务应用都只问一次家务有多难，对所有人一视同仁。ChoreDivider则私下问每个人：这件事对你来说有多耗神？在所有人都完成之前，评分始终密封。然后它按天分配，让14天内的分钟数保持均衡，没人会分到自己最怕的家务。每项家务都会说明，为什么落到你头上。没有积分，没有排行榜。
products.description: Every chore app asks how hard a chore is, once, for everyone. ChoreDivider asks each of you, in private: how draining is this for you? Ratings stay sealed until everyone is done. Then it deals each day so minutes stay even over 14 days and nobody gets the chore they dread. Every chore says, why it landed with you. No points, no leaderboard.

products.name: Storytailor®
products.tagline: A personal world built around your child’s imagination
products.summaryZh: 围绕孩子想象力构建的个人世界
products.descriptionZh: 重建后的 Storytailor 将孩子的想法和画作转化为反复出现的角色和图文故事，服务于家庭、教育工作者和照护团队。可以一起阅读或聆听，用 Wonder Words™ 探索陌生词汇，并通过线下活动继续延伸。围绕日常问题、重大变化或纯粹的胡闹来创作故事，角色能反映孩子的世界。教育者故事包含教案。前两个故事免费。
products.description: The rebuilt Storytailor turns children’s ideas and drawings into recurring characters and illustrated stories for families, educators and care teams. Read or listen together, explore unfamiliar words with Wonder Words™, and keep going with off-screen activities. Create stories around everyday questions, big changes or pure silliness, with characters that reflect the child’s world. Educator stories include lesson plans. Your first two stories are free.
